embedded_persona_count_note: FDN-7 / F1.3 gate 3 — the 5th SET-triad member: COUNT(DISTINCT persona_id) actually embedded in the PUBLISHED release asset (gemini-index.sqlite.gz). Written by shared-utils/prebuilt-index/build-and-publish.sh from the real asset; a --no-asset staging bump (persona_fleet.py set-manifest-counts) deliberately DOES NOT touch it, so it lags persona_count and asset_rebuild_required flips to true. When asset_rebuild_required is false this MUST equal persona_count/canonical_persona_count; a mismatch means the SET carries a counted-but-vector-less persona (Layer-5 degrades to keyword). delta_provider_backstamp.defect: gemini-section-indexer.py INSERT omitted provider/model/dim columns. The 11 delta personas added to v2.2.0 arrived with provider=NULL, model=NULL, dim=NULL. init_db() backfill only fires when columns are absent — it never re-runs on existing NULL rows — so the prebuilt v2.2.0 asset shipped with 161 blank-provider rows across the 11 newest personas.
